556:t_3:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Who...? Is that my voice? No... I didn't say anything...)

556:t_3:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Static... It's because of that unpleasant man's voice earlier...)

556:t_3:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
(Shut up... Stop it... Stop it... Stop it...)

556:t_3:16.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Who are you calling a bitch, $$宗介$$!!」

556:t_3:20.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, you! You gloomy, quiet-type Sergeant!」

556:t_3:21.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I kept my mouth shut and listened, and you just say whatever you want! Yes, yes... it's all my fault!」

556:t_3:22.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Because I wasn't strong enough, things ended up like this, right!」

556:t_3:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah, yeah, sorry about that! For mailboxes being red and utility poles being tall! It's all my fault!」

556:t_3:24.en:
$$かなめ$$
「But I'm not letting 'bitch' slide! I had my own hardships too!」

556:t_3:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「By any common sense, it should've been impossible for me to be yelling at you like this right now!」

556:t_3:26.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I was just an ordinary high school girl, you know! Couldn't you at least say a little something to thank me for my trouble!?」

556:t_3:27.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And then... what kind of talk is that!? So high and mighty, 'I'm disappointed'! 'Big liar'!?」

556:t_3:28.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Why do I have to take that from a war-crazed, gloomy guy like you! I'M the one who's disappointed!」

556:t_3:29.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You had some time, didn't you!? Couldn't you have come up with some sweeter words or something!? Why are you like that right up to the very end!?」

556:t_3:30.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What's the harm!? Even if you said it with snot running down your nose, 'I lub you, Ganameee~!'」

556:t_3:31.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Oh, you can't? You can't say it? So that's basically it? You're already sick of me?」

556:t_3:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
「The truth is you don't care about me at all, and you're blaming it on me? Is that how this goes?」

556:t_3:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Or maybe you're already together with $$テッサ$$, is that the punchline? Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah, fine, whatever. She's such a good girl, after all.」

556:t_3:34.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Not a spineless, idiotic, big-liar bitch like me, right!」

556:t_3:35.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I don't care anymore, I don't care. Turn around and go home, idiot! Just leave me alone and do whatever you want!」

556:t_3:37.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(She came out just to say something like this... Just to vent such a ridiculous, childish grudge...)

556:t_3:38.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(Now that I've been separated from her like this, I can understand...)

556:t_3:39.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(So she is $$千鳥かなめ$$... And I am... $$ソフィア$$.)

556:t_3:40.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(I was deceiving myself... Deceiving both myself and her.)

556:t_3:41.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(But it's still all right. This time I will truly make this girl submit. Torment her, crush her, make her obey.)

556:t_3:42.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(And so I will bring about the transformation. I, who am without falsehood.)

556:t_3:44.en:
$$かなめ$$
(I could finally scream. Thanks to him...)

556:t_3:47.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What will you do, $$ソフィア$$?」

556:t_3:48.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「It's already begun, hasn't it? Let's just see it through.」

556:t_3:51.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You're the one who started this. It has nothing to do with me. I can't cooperate.」

556:t_3:52.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「I thought you would say that.」

556:t_3:53.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「I've known for a long time. Ever since I began whispering to you, you've always been defiant, aggressive...」

556:t_3:54.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You... don't you understand how unreasonable your demand is?」

556:t_3:55.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Because I don't need to explain, do I? Until just now, you were me.」

556:t_3:56.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I feel sorry for you. But even so, it's wrong to steal someone else's life and live a lie.」

556:t_3:58.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「I died unhappy, in misery. Are you telling me to just accept that?」

556:t_3:59.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Sacrificed for the experiment at $$ヤムスク$$ 18 years ago... Are you telling me to accept ending a life like that?」

556:t_3:60.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's... terrible, I think. It's really... terrible...」

556:t_3:61.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Thank you. You're a kind girl. You truly do sympathize with me.」

556:t_3:63.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Even so! My heart... my life is mine! I can't give it to you!」

556:t_3:64.en:
$$かなめ$$
「And I can't allow you to sacrifice the lives of everyone in the world to redo the world, either.」

556:t_3:65.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「But it's necessary. And in the new world, everyone can live happy and healthy. Is there a problem?」

556:t_3:66.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'll say it once more. I won't cooperate.」

556:t_3:67.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Are you really okay with that? With backing out?」

556:t_3:68.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Could you still say the same after watching the last moments of the person you love, fighting out there right now?」

556:t_4:4.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「With the cockpit pierced, he's finished.」

556:t_4:6.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「This isn't an illusion like the ones you saw at $$ヤムスク$$. It's happening in reality.」

556:t_4:7.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Well? Even now, you don't feel like choosing to start over from scratch?」

556:t_4:8.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「I don't want to accept it, I can never allow it... You knew this feeling, and still you lectured me.」

556:t_4:9.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Acting as if you'd overcome it. Did you understand that arrogance? Could you imagine it, even a little?」

556:t_4:11.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「You remember, don't you? Feeling exactly the way you do now.」

556:t_4:12.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「Four years ago, when you lost your mother...」

556:t_4:14.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「That's right. You didn't overcome it. You were only holding back from crying out all this time.」

556:t_4:16.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「That something like this could happen twice... You can't accept a reality like that, can you?」

556:t_4:17.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「So picture it. What do you want to do...」

556:t_4:18.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「A life surrounded by family and friends... A peaceful society with no connection to war...」

556:t_4:19.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「And by your side, the person who matters most to you...」

556:t_4:21.en:
$$ソフィア$$
「And then, I become you...」

556:t_4:25.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(Soon the world will be wrapped in light...)

556:t_4:26.en:
$$ソフィア$$
(What awaits there is her... no, the world I wished for...)

ヤムスク.evidence: Yamsk-11 (ヤムスク１１) is in the glossary as Yamsk-11; Yamsk is the Soviet facility in Full Metal Panic! where Sophia/Kaname's 18-year-old experiment took place; 18 years before = Sophia's death

ヤムスク alone is not in the glossary (only ヤムスク１１ keyword): proposed $$ヤムスク$$ = Yamsk.
